text:
emma_orpheus: Hi team — forwarding our auditor's request and a problem we hit during an export. Auditor needs proof that key material is HSM-wrapped and an exportable audit log for the last 90 days. Deadline: Tue EOD. Also, when we tried to download the export we intermittently got 401s and saw a billing spike. Logs attached/inline.

emma_orpheus: curl -i -H \"Authorization: Bearer <redacted>\" \"https://api.redwood.ai/v1/export/keys?job=exp-2026-11-04-09\"
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
content-type: application/json
{"error":"invalid_client", "detail":"token expired"}

Priya (CS): @emma_orpheus thanks for raising. Can you confirm org id and export job id? Also did you perform a key rotation or change service accounts recently? Looping in @Jordan (SE) and @Max (Security).

emma_orpheus: org=orpheus-fin, job=exp-2026-11-04-09, no manual rotations on our side. Token was the one UI produced when starting the export. Auditor insists on a signed artifact showing HSM wrapping (not the raw keys) + an audit log snippet tying the export event to our org.

Jordan (SE): I reproduced the 401 on our staging mirror with the same pattern — long-running export + UI short-lived token renewal causes a race where the client uses an expired token for the download call. Repro steps:
1) Start export from UI
2) Poll /v1/export/status every 2s
3) When status -> ready, call /v1/export/download with the UI token -> intermittent 401

Jordan (SE): Quick workaround: from org settings generate a service token (long-lived) and use that for the download step. This avoids the token refresh race. We'll prepare a patch to decouple the export download auth from the short-lived UI token.

Max (Security): We can produce two artifacts: (A) a signed HSM attest file (hash + signature) showing key wrapping metadata, and (B) a sanitized audit export covering the requested 90 days. We will NOT include raw key material. Need customer consent form + internal approval to release the audit blob. Redaction policy: IPs and bearer tokens will be redacted.

Priya (CS): Legal confirmed customer NDA covers auditor access. @emma_orpheus please sign the release form (I will DM the link). ETA from security: signed HSM attest in ~48 hours, sanitized audit export in ~72 hours.

emma_orpheus: thanks. We can sign. For the auditor they also want a short note describing the cause of the 401s so they can close that finding.

Jordan (SE): I'll draft a short root-cause note: \"Intermittent 401s on export download caused by token refresh race between UI short-lived tokens and export download flow. Workaround: use service token or retry on 401; permanent fix scheduled (canary tonight).\"

deploybot: canary deploy started for auth-fix (release/auth-fix-2026-11-05)

billing-bot: Alert: unusual token consumption detected for org orpheus-fin between 2026-11-03T08:00Z and 2026-11-04T12:00Z. Billing team will follow up if spike persists.

Priya (CS): @emma_orpheus I'll send the release form + next steps email. We'll post the HSM attest and sanitized audit export here when ready. Jordan — please confirm canary status and rollback plan after deploy. Max — please confirm the exact filename(s) and hash we will share so we can reference them in the auditor response. :thumbsup:
